items.source:
Note that a PropertyAccessor used by a BindingResult should
always have its "extractOldValueForEditor" flag set to "true"
by default, since this is typically possible without side effects
for model objects that serve as data binding target.
items.translation: 注意，BindingResult 使用的 PropertyAccessor 应始终默认将 "extractOldValueForEditor" 标志设置为 "true"，因为对于作为数据绑定目标的模型对象来说，这通常不会产生副作用。

items.source: Abstract base class for BindingResult implementations that work with Spring's PropertyAccessor mechanism. Pre-implements field access through delegation to the corresponding PropertyAccessor methods.
items.translation: 与 Spring 的PropertyAccessor机制配合使用的 BindingResult实现类的抽象基类。通过委托到相应的 PropertyAccessor 方法预先实现了字段访问。

items.source: field - the path of the property (name or nested path), or null if looking for an editor for all properties of the given type
items.translation: field - 属性的路径（名称或嵌套路径），或者如果正在查找给定类型所有属性的编辑器，则为 null。

items.source: valueType - the type of the property (can be null if a property is given but should be specified in any case for consistency checking)
items.translation: valueType - 属性的类型（如果已提供属性，该值可以为 null，但为了保持一致性检查，在任何情况下都应指定）
